intro.heading: Uniworld Seine River Cruises: Paris & Normandy
leadParagraphs: The Seine River flows through the historic heart of northern France, offering a magical journey through art, culture, and history. A Uniworld Seine River Cruise provides a premier way to experience the romance of Paris and the storied shores of Normandy in unparalleled boutique luxury.

From the iconic monuments of the City of Light to the beautiful gardens of Giverny that inspired Claude Monet, and the moving landing beaches of Normandy, every bend of the river brings a new adventure. Onboard, guests enjoy gourmet French-inspired dining, all-inclusive premium drinks, and the signature personalized service of Uniworld's elegant floating boutique hotels.
Whether you are a history buff, an art enthusiast, or a lover of fine food and wine, this itinerary offers an unforgettable French escape.

faqs.question: Is a Uniworld Seine River Cruise worth the money?
faqs.answer: Yes. It offers luxury accommodations, gourmet dining, premium beverages, excursions, and personalized service in one all-inclusive vacation.

faqs.question: What is included on a Seine River Cruise?
faqs.answer: Accommodations, dining, drinks, Wi-Fi, excursions, gratuities, and entertainment.

faqs.question: Does the cruise visit Paris?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most itineraries begin or end in Paris.

faqs.question: Can I visit the Normandy Beaches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guided excursions to the historic D-Day beaches are available on many itineraries.

faqs.question: Does the cruise visit Monet's Garden?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many itineraries include Giverny and Monet's famous gardens.

faqs.question: When is the best time to cruise the Seine?
faqs.answer: Spring and fall offer ideal weather and fewer crowds.

faqs.question: Who should choose this itinerary?
faqs.answer: Couples, luxury travelers, history enthusiasts, and food lovers.

faqs.question: Is the Seine River Cruise good for first-time visitors to France?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. It combines Paris, Normandy, and charming French villages in one itinerary.
